title: Les soins aux animaux domestiques
through_line: Un animal tombe malade, on apprend à le voir et à le soigner.

blocks.vo_line: Les animaux de la maison peuvent tomber malades.
blocks.shot: A quiet Cameroonian courtyard with red earth, a goat lying down with its head low, a hen standing still nearby, soft overcast light. Keep the lower left corner calm and uncluttered.

blocks.vo_line: La gale et la teigne abîment la peau et le poil.
blocks.shot: A close calm view of an animal flank with a plain uniform coat, showing three clearly round bare patches where the hair has fallen out. Keep the lower left corner calm and uncluttered.

blocks.vo_line: La grippe donne la toux, la bave et la fatigue.
blocks.shot: A hen resting with drooping wings beside a bowl of water, head low, a soft blanket of warm light around her. Keep the lower left corner calm and uncluttered.

blocks.vo_line: La rage fait beaucoup baver et rend l’animal agressif.
blocks.shot: Seen from a safe distance: a lone dog far away beside a puddle, head low, while an adult gently leads a child away along a path, both seen from behind. Keep the lower left corner calm and uncluttered.

blocks.vo_line: On vaccine, on nettoie l’habitat, on va chez le vétérinaire.
blocks.shot: A clean swept animal shelter with fresh straw and a bucket of clear water, a small medical bag on a stool, the goat standing again and alert. Keep the lower left corner calm and uncluttered.
